judgments.reason: While 'morning stiffness' does appear literally in the vignette, the clinical record overwhelmingly supports a diagnosis of systemic sclerosis (scleroderma) with overlap features rather than Rheumatoid Arthritis. The completed label 'Rheumatoid Arthritis with morning stiffness' is not a reasonable diagnosis given the totality of findings (skin thickening, Raynaud phenomenon, capillaroscopy late signs, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, ANA mitochondrial pattern, skin biopsy with increased collagen). Morning stiffness alone does not clinically support RA as the parent diagnosis, so the modifier cannot be considered a reasonable part of the completed diagnosis label.
